title: Automated, steerable Story checklist: citation check, proofreading, triggered procedures, monitoring and human touchpoints
description:
Planning not finished (Ryan 2026-11-08). Vision: new checklist steps (citation check in three parts: real sources, sources support claims, citation style per story type read from site editorial-policy data; real proofreading, since copy_edit is only the Humanus rule check and fact_check is not built, PPY-719a02; quotes and numbers, links, plagiarism, headline accuracy, legal screen, disclosure, corrections). Each step run by a Tactus procedure whose agent system prompt is a per-site admin setting beside mission and policies; commands generated from one operation table for CLI and MCP; procedures triggered by Story stage transitions; monitoring; and human touchpoints at the right moments through branded Caducus notification emails that link to the newsroom pages. Related: PPY-59c772 (four-lens review), PPY-9ff95b (automation), PPY-719a02 (fact-check). Opus design review: ~/Projects/knowledge-runs/architecture/story-automation-design-20261108.md (in progress). Stories are added after Ryan answers the open questions.

**Always-on agent standard (2026-11-16; design `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md`)**
This epic is the Story lifecycle's client of the always-on agent standard (initiative PPY-a3fceb). Its step runner (PPY-8a374e) is the standard's change feed for the Item table and now sits under the inbox epic (PPY-cd706f). The autonomy level in the Story procedure profile (PPY-7a61ca) is a rung on the one ladder (PPY-51ea61): `review_first` is `prepare`, `publish_then_review` is `publish_soft`, `full_auto` is `publish_auto`. Step outcomes use the five-word vocabulary (PPY-f58445). Email nudges (PPY-e2d276) are the standard's outbox to people.
